Definition: from the alternate of G4095; a drinking-bout or carousal:--banqueting.
BiblicalUsage: Potos is a drinking bout, a carousal, banqueting. Peter lists it among the things of the old life: excess of wine, revellings, banquetings, and abominable idolatries, things the Gentiles thought were living.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Peter names the old life plainly so the new life can be seen plainly, and the difference is the whole point.
